$comment: Machine-readable index of REOP releases. Consumers, the reop.io site (tools/sync-protocol.mjs in REOP-IO/reop-site) and the REOP app CI (reop:vendor) read this file. `releaseUrl` is the GitHub Release of a version (absent for versions that pre-date GitHub Releases). `current` is the version new documents MUST declare; `supported` versions are still accepted by readers of the same major; `deprecated` versions have a published migration path.

versions.notes: Consolidation release: ProjectDocument and InventoryUpdate documents, MediaAsset / FileAsset / Experience objects, one logo plus credited logos, unit galleries and floor plans, rooms and bedrooms as independent facts, extended inventory, entity-specific marketing, extensions, published vocabularies, ISO 4217 currencies.

Extended language support: LocalizedString everywhere, 11 contact channels, 12 social networks, enums for amenities, interests, views and orientations. Known drift: the JSON Schema omits members the YAML defines (contact channels beyond whatsapp, social networks beyond linkedin, gardenAreaSqm, Unit.startingPrice, Floor.number required). The YAML is authoritative for 1.3.0; both files are frozen.
Flattened architecture: developers[] and projects[] linked by ids (many-to-many).
Nested hierarchy Developer > Project > Building > Floor > UnitModel > Unit; decoupled inventory; multi-language; marketing and legal layers; standardized enums.
